changes.title: Take discovered stairs with one shortcut
changes.text: Choose Stairs Up or Stairs Down to walk there and automatically use the stairs when the optional Auto-enter Stairs on Arrival setting is enabled. The hero still pays normal walking turns and stops for enemies, danger, damage and interruptions.

changes.title: Keep stair entry optional and preserve existing movement behavior
changes.text: The new setting starts off and saves independently from the staircase shortcut. Tests cover entering or staying on stairs, blocked routes, interrupted travel, the previous movement API and touchscreen controls. Ordinary tile taps and other movement do not automatically change floors.
